verdict.rationale: Jitsu is an event-collection and warehouse-delivery pipeline, and a data platform could plausibly ship in-product AI insights, so this axis applies. The evidence documents no in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions about the user's data. The MCP server lets external AI agents configure the pipeline and inspect Live Events, which is an adjacent capability rather than AI insights delivered inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
